title: C++: Functors (Function Objects)
description: Create function objects (functors) for use with STL algorithms.

steps.title: Functor Examples
steps.description: Define a functor `Adder` that takes an int and returns the sum of the argument and its stored value. Define `Comparer` that compares absolute values for sorting. Use Comparer with std::sort to sort {-3, 1, -2, 5, -4} by absolute value.
hints: struct Adder { int val; Adder(int v) : val(v) {} int operator()(int x) { return x + val; } };
struct AbsCompare { bool operator()(int a, int b) { return abs(a) < abs(b); } };
